items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation for claim substantiation, even when the police report is required for cover. None of the 68 lines is payable.
Clauses 7.1.8(e) and (f) exclude the provider's working materials and surcharges accompanying the excluded translation. The entire charge is excluded.

items.description: Robbery compensation for stolen watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed robbery is covered away from home under 2.3 and 11.1. Subject to the evidence required by 7.1.10, the watch is estimated to reach its €2,500 per-item limit and the cash exceeds its €500 limit; the combined €3,000 is below the €5,000 away-from-home limit, and the single €50 deductible leaves €2,950.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding and shipping charges even when they appear on the same statement as covered property compensation. The entire charge is excluded.
